method: BASELINE. Seat-neutral core in the chapter's own actors and terms, with regulative rules for the filing and payment duties, and a taxpayer seat layer built from it; written straight from the deposited text with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (parts not encoded answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Kentucky Revised Statutes (LRC; enactments through the 2026 Regular Session; database updated 10/19/2026), chapter 141 individual income tax sections, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/krs-141-individual-income-tax.txt (retrieved 2026-10-19 UTC). The CPI-indexed standard deduction and the HHS poverty guidelines are inputs.

checks.command: l4 run ky-income-tax.l4 ; l4 run ky-income-tax-seat.l4 ; l4 run ky-income-tax-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: KRS 141.010(23), (25), (32); 141.019 (main adjustments); 141.020(1), (2)(e)-(g), (3)(a)4-8; 141.021 as an input; 141.0205(2); 141.066(1), (3), (4); 141.067; 141.069; 141.081 as an input; 141.160(1); 141.180(2), (3); 141.220. Not covered (asserted): years before 2024, a rate cut by Act from 2027, nonresidents and part-year residents, the other-state credit. Read with subjects/us/internal-revenue-code-of-1986/ for the federal inputs.
seat: the individual taxpayer (a full-year Kentucky resident for the tax computation)
